description: RAGJAO crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C46 H46 La2 N10 O14. From the CIF bond table, La1 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La2 (La) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.800-3.800 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 94.31-102.02°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [La2(HL)2(H2L)(NO3)(CH3OH)(H2O)]. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
